title: Cooperative Customer Qualification
description: Applicant provides complete, valid business details and qualifies smoothly.
turns: Hello, I'd like to check if my company qualifies for a business loan.
My business name is Nexus Technology LLC. We've been operating for 3 years.
Our annual revenue is $250,000 and monthly cashflow is around $20,000.
I am looking to borrow $50,000 for purchasing inventory.

title: Interest Rate Objection Handling
description: Applicant challenges interest rates; bot retrieves grounded explanation from Q2.
turns: I run Apex Global LLC, 2 years operating history, $150,000 revenue.
Why is your interest rate so high for unsecured loans?

title: Conflicting Business Details
description: Applicant provides contradictory revenue figures ($500k annual vs $10k monthly).
turns: My business is Vantage Retail LLC, operating for 24 months.
My annual revenue is $500,000, but recent monthly cashflow is $10,000.

title: Out-of-Scope Fallback
description: Applicant asks for personal tax filing advice not covered by Q2 KB.
turns: My business is Horizon Corp, 2 years operating history.
How do I file my personal residential mortgage tax deduction in Texas?

title: Customer Requests Human Assistance
description: Applicant explicitly demands a human agent; bot triggers immediate escalation handoff.
turns: I want to speak with a human loan officer right now.
